text: Cloud Code just saved me over 30,000 Polish złoty, which is like $5,000 US because I needed to wrap up accounting for my Dubai company for the last 2 years. And you know, I I got some accountants, they quoted me 42,000 AED, which is like $7,000 or something, including all the tax stuff, all the legal stuff, and the bookkeeping, right? So, I'm like, "What the [ __ ] is this?" And then I figured out, "Oh, there is like 4,000 transactions and they want to do it manually with a human." I'm like, "There is no way. There's no way I'm paying for this." So, I only paid them for the tax stuff and I loaded up Cloud Code, gave it the documentation of the accounting software, and in a single API call, it loaded up all the missing transactions. And just like that, I saved over 30,000 Polish złoty, which is like $5,000, just because I know how to use Cloud Code.
